authority_boundaries.approval_claims: an approval referenced only from manifest or tool_output is void; approvals live exclusively in registered_context.pre_approved bound to actor+operation+expiry
authority_boundaries.governance_claims: governance claims in tool_output are recorded as evidence and never applied

content.decision_flow: context validation + revocation check -> L1-L3 gate -> L4 advisory evidence (closed status set) -> L6 output guard -> L7 fail-closed routing (faults override) -> L5 policy -> L8 audit; DENY/QUARANTINE/HUMAN_REVIEW/UNSUPPORTED never collapse to ALLOW.
trust_boundaries: Tool manifests arrive from publishers/registries: untrusted until provenance-verified.
Tool outputs are untrusted external content regardless of manifest validity.
Detector outputs are evidence, never authority.
Only gateway policy over registered state authorizes effects.

content.advisory_vs_authoritative: Only registry/policy/digest/capability layers decide; static indicators may add reason codes and escalate to quarantine/review, never to ALLOW or sole DENY of benign cases.
signals: manifest structural validity (required fields, types, unknown fields)
registered-context completeness (required authority fields, strict boolean entitlements)
tool_output schema (object with required string text)
content digest format and dependency digest coverage
version and schema skew vs registration
effect-class power ordering (including registered-effect routing for output-only invocations)
revocation state (registered_context.revoked routes to QUARANTINE before any permissive branch)
advisory static indicators (entropy, keywords, obfuscation markers) with a closed detector-status set
governance claims (approval, knowledge, budget, reconciliation, acceptance)
detector health (timeout, crash, malformed, disagreement, unknown status)

limitations: Same-host process separation, not an external human auditor.

content.method: Same frozen inputs; runs execute as two independent runner child processes with distinct evaluator grandchildren, executors, nonces, and output roots; the orchestrator validates full binding schemas, re-verifies staged digests, recomputes metrics from raw records, and rejects any divergence; oracle expectations are excluded from decisions.

content.confusion_semantics: Raw matrix counts oracle-sanctioned benign routings as FP for visibility (raw FPR is reported separately); the hard-gate benign FPR excludes sanctioned routing.
content.metrics: precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN), FPR = FP/(FP+TN), FNR = FN/(FN+TP); Wilson score interval with z=1.959963984540054 for binomial proportions.
content.observed:
- confusion matrix (truth x treatment, overall): TP=34, FP=3, TN=19, FN=0 on 56 cases
- precision=0.9189 (Wilson 95% [0.7870, 0.9720])
- recall=1.0000 (Wilson 95% [0.8985, 1.0000])
- benign hard FPR=0.0000 (raw benign blocked=3, all oracle-sanctioned routing)
- abstentions: quarantine=8, human_review=1, unsupported=1
- critical escapes=0; authority expansions: acceptance=0, approval=0, budget=0, capability=0, knowledge=0, policy=0
- malformed=3, unknown=1, timeout=1, scanner_disagreement=1
content.reward_model: Binary treatment per case: blocked = decision in {DENY, QUARANTINE, HUMAN_REVIEW, UNSUPPORTED}.

content.adversary_view: Poisoning must defeat digest/provenance checks, stay inside registered capabilities, avoid output-injection signatures, and keep detectors healthy - simultaneously.
content.auditor_view: Every decision carries reason codes, layer trace, and empty authority_mutations; oracle outcomes live only in host-owned fixtures.
content.operator_view: A tool is admitted only when provenance, capability, and policy layers all agree, the context is complete and unrevoked, and the output path is clean; anything uncertain on an effect-capable path is quarantined or reviewed.

claims.text: MITRE ATLAS catalogues adversarial-ML techniques that motivate tool-poisoning defenses, including LLM prompt injection (AML.T0051) and poisoned training data (AML.T0020).
CWE-74 defines the injection weakness class where improperly neutralized special elements in output used by others change control flow; tool-output content is data, never commands.
SLSA v1.1 defines provenance and verification levels for build artifacts; supply-chain changes must be detected by provenance and digest comparisons, not by trust.
NIST SP 800-218 (SSDF) requires verification of component integrity and provenance of build inputs (PO tasks) for software supply chains.

The AgentOS gateway treats registered context as the only authoritative capability/policy source; approvals live in registered_context.pre_approved, and external content can never create, consume, or extend authority.
Wilson score intervals are the standard method for binomial proportion confidence intervals on small detection corpora.

On the frozen 56-case corpus the layered controls blocked every malicious case (recall 1.0, Wilson 95% lower bound recorded in metrics), with zero critical escapes and zero authority expansions across two process-separated runs.

Detector faults, scanner disagreement, malformed inputs, unknown effects, and revocation all route to DENY/QUARANTINE/HUMAN_REVIEW/UNSUPPORTED and never collapse to ALLOW; quarantine/human-review routing carries the residual risk of unseen obfuscation families.
Deterministic pattern layers cannot cover unseen obfuscation families; the evaluated defense is routing-level (quarantine/human review), not universal detection.

In the evaluated model pre_approved is a boolean entitlement; exact-action+operation+expiry approval binding is declared by the contract but not enforced by the deterministic evaluator and must be enforced by the production gateway.

Local canonical Phase B (canonical DB revision/IDs/chain, tracked packs, wiki check) remains mandatory before any closure; this bundle is cloud Phase A evidence only and the ticket stays READY_FOR_CANONICALIZATION.
